publicEndpoints.notes: Server validates all children, town, one preferred day and per-day windows. Enforce closure, complete documents after deadline. Idempotency-Key mandatory. Return only opaque receipt. Persist request and acknowledgement-mail outbox atomically.
Exchange token for a short secure session scoped to exactly one request. Server stores token hash only.
Only this family visit, never list other requests.
Enforce document deadline on server. Confirmed slot/tour/status never accepted from family payload.
Private validated upload linked to owned child, enforce deadline and size/type. Finalize only after verified storage.

adminEndpoints.notes: Paginated private data, never cache publicly.
Transactional immutable slot and outbox. Optimistic version check and concurrent capacity check. Email state independent.
Duration, tour, order; reject changes to a locked tour or confirmed slot. Log changes.
Explicit audited correction including after deadline.
Enqueue idempotent retry of failed or unsent mail. Never unconfirm appointment.
Affect new planning only. Confirmed visits unchanged.
Validate confirmed visits, time/reordering conflicts, capacity.
Private print package with complete child text and attachments, no public URL.
